title: Shipping an Allocated Reservation — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Fulfilment Rule
content:
**Rule.** An allocated Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation ships on a fulfilment order by the type's delivery service at the type's shipping fee. It ships separately from the rest of the original basket at no extra charge. A Supplier Direct Back-Order ships from the brand's warehouse in its own parcel. A Standard Back-Order of several units may ship units as they arrive. Marlowe Rewards points are earned on the fulfilment order at its dispatch, never on a deposit. Once the item has shipped, delivery issues follow Delivery Claims and returns follow Returns & Exchanges, with the fulfilment order's delivered date as the anchor.

**What the fulfilment order carries**

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Delivery service and fee | Those of the reservation type |
| Separate shipment from the original basket | No extra charge |
| Marlowe Rewards points | Earned at dispatch of the fulfilment order; none on a deposit |
| Date used for later claims and returns | The fulfilment order's delivered date |

**Cases (hypothetical)**

- A Standard Back-Order of 3 units, of which 2 have arrived. The 2 units may ship now, and the third ships when it arrives.
- A Supplier Direct Back-Order arrives from the brand. It leaves the brand's warehouse in its own parcel.
- A Deposit Pre-Order ships. Its points are earned when the fulfilment order is dispatched, on that order and not on the deposit paid months earlier.
- A parcel from a fulfilment order arrives damaged. The matter follows Delivery Claims, counted from the fulfilment order's delivered date.
